args.body:
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to address CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays; affected: <2.9.4, >=3.0.0 <3.1.0; fixed in 2.9.4 / 3.1.0).

CI: passed (run ci-0001).
